zh: 一、先把「名冊、識別證、文件櫃」接起來
en: 1. Connect the Staff Directory, ID Badge, and Filing Cabinet

zh: 二、查帳號資料，和查「正在做事的程式」是兩件事
en: 2. Looking Up an Account Is Different from Checking the Program Doing the Work

zh: 三、同名帳號跨到 NFS，還要核對伺服器收到的身分
en: 3. With NFS, Matching Names Still Require Checking the Identity the Server Receives

zh: 四、權限要看對象：目錄的 r／x，不等於檔案的 r
en: 4. Permissions Depend on the Object: Directory r/x Is Not File r

zh: 五、看一份合成紀錄：名稱相同，資料夾能列出，檔案仍遭拒
en: 5. Read a Synthetic Record: Same Name, Directory Listing Works, File Access Still Denied

zh: 六、列舉工具知道多少，結論就寫到哪裡
en: 6. Keep Your Conclusions Within What the Enumeration Tools Establish
